targets.notes: Exact key match between issue #713 and the landed source report; no alternate key name observed.

The landed source report's own local_aggregate.caps_db.targets names the pre-existing canonical keys 'Access approval policies & requests (JIT access)' (policy.access_approval_workflow) and 'Secret approval policies & requests' (policy.secret_approval_workflow) as the capabilities the decision_ledger expiry/next-best-action columns and the expired-only GET /api/holding/feed filter fall under.
